provenance.builtDuring: Phase 3.8.5 (Real Windows Audio Capture & Live Speech Pipeline) - rebuilt to package a fix for the operator's real Windows report: CIP enumerates real input devices (Microphone - Iriun Webcam, Stereo Mix - Realtek(R) Audio, Microphone Array - Intel Smart Sound, Line In) and lets the operator select one, but reports 'SPEECH UNAVAILABLE - manual operation remains available' and never starts audio capture at all. Root cause, confirmed by direct code tracing (docs/phase-3-8-5-audit.md): `start_listening` checked `speech_engine.is_ready()` and returned `SpeechEngineError::NotInitialized` *before* ever calling `audio_engine.start(...)` - so on every Windows build to date (none has ever included the `whisper` feature/model), audio capture could never start regardless of which real device the operator selected, even though `AudioEngine` and `SpeechEngine` are documented (docs/live-speech.md) as independent capabilities and the rest of the pipeline (handle_audio_chunk's per-chunk feed_audio error handling, the SpeechEngine trait's own NotInitialized contract) already tolerates speech being unavailable gracefully. Fix: removed the pre-flight is_ready() gate from start_listening so audio capture starts unconditionally (subject to the existing, unchanged device-resolution/AudioEngineError handling); speech readiness is now checked only after a successful audio_engine.start(), purely to decide whether AppEvent::SpeechStarted/SpeechStopped are honestly emitted - never fabricated when no speech engine is ready. The frontend's Start Listening button no longer disables on speechStatus==='unavailable', and the already-computed RMS input_level is now rendered in the Audio & Speech panel so the operator can see NO SIGNAL vs SIGNAL CAPTURED independently of transcription.

This is a freshly compiled build (`cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` via `tauri build`), not a copy of a prior artifact.

releaseCandidateStatement: This is the Phase 3.8.5 SOFTWARE RELEASE CANDIDATE for Windows x64 (Real Windows Audio Capture & Live Speech Pipeline). It is a real, verifiable build artifact - not a placeholder, not a simulation, not a fabrication. See docs/phase-3-8-5-live-audio-pipeline.md for the full PASS/HOLD breakdown and final gate.
physicalHardwareStatement: Physical hardware qualification has NOT been performed in the build environment. This installer has not been installed, launched, or tested on any real Windows machine, and no real microphone/Stereo-Mix audio device has captured audio through it. No real Whisper transcription, no real second display/projector, no real WebView2 runtime, and no real human operator workflow has been exercised against this build. This phase's automated Rust/frontend regression suite is full green (Environment A), but this session's container was additionally unable to launch a GUI window under Xvfb at all for this phase (Environment B) - reproduced identically on the unmodified Phase 3.8.4 baseline binary, so this is a session/container limitation, not a Phase 3.8.5 regression (see pilot-evidence/3.8.5/xvfb/environment-b-not-available.json for the full isolation test). Environment A/B evidence and cross-compilation success are never substituted for Environment C (real hardware) evidence anywhere in this project's documentation. The applied fix is proven correct by direct code tracing against this codebase's own documented architecture (docs/live-speech.md's 'four independent signals') and by the full-green regression suite, but the live-audio pipeline itself (real device -> CPAL capture -> input level -> optional transcription -> Bible/Sermon Intelligence) has not been exercised end-to-end with real audio in this container.
githubReleaseStatus: NOT CONFIGURED - no .github/workflows directory exists in this repository, and no GitHub Release has been created for this artifact. This installer is available only via this repository's working tree (release/windows/), not via GitHub Releases or any CI/CD pipeline.
obtainingWithoutDeveloperTooling: The file at release/windows/Church Intelligence Platform_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe can be copied/transferred directly (e.g. via a git clone of this repository, a direct file download, or a USB drive) to the target Windows machine and run there. Running the installer on Windows requires none of: Claude Code, Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, or the CIP source tree - only the .exe file itself.
knownLimitations: UNSIGNED release candidate - Windows SmartScreen will show an 'unknown publisher' warning on first run
Cross-compiled from Linux, never launch-tested on real Windows hardware - Environment C remains not performed for THIS rebuilt artifact

This build was never built with the `whisper` feature (no Windows artifact in this project's history has been), so speechStatus will report 'unavailable' on this build regardless of this phase's fix - this phase's fix makes audio capture (input level, acoustic/music recognition) work WITHOUT transcription on such a build, not transcription itself; a real Whisper model must still be placed at the configured path (see docs/live-speech.md) for live transcription

Environment B (Xvfb GUI reproduction) could not be established in this session's container for this phase - confirmed as a session/container limitation via a controlled isolation test against the unmodified Phase 3.8.4 baseline binary, not a Phase 3.8.5 regression (pilot-evidence/3.8.5/xvfb/environment-b-not-available.json)

Music Library is legitimately empty in a production build - no licensed production song dataset exists in this repository; Service Replay's default flow does not exercise Music Intelligence for this reason

The ground-up visual/UX redesign described aspirationally in the original Phase 3.8 spec was deliberately not attempted this phase either - scope remained limited to the specific audio-capture defect the operator reported
See docs/phase-3-8-5-live-audio-pipeline.md and pilot-evidence/3.8.5/ for the full Environment A/B/C evidence breakdown
